title: Very Organized Executive Assistant, Brand & Social Media heavy Remote | USA EST hours
description:
The application instructions at the bottom are specific. Only apply if you have direct experience as an assistant and with the applications below.



About us



We are a skincare brand serving women with acne-prone, barrier-compromised skin. We've been doing this for over fifteen years long before holistic skincare was a category anyone was chasing. Our clients don't find us through ads. They find us because someone they trust told them we were the ones who finally listened.



We're entering a new chapter. Our founder is stepping forward publicly as the lead content creator for the brand and the work ahead is connecting the woman who built this to the women it was built for.



We are a high-performance team. The pace is real and the standards are high but so is the care. We communicate directly, we don't let people struggle in silence, and we take genuine pride in what leaves our hands.



What this role is



We're hiring an assistant with strong social media skills — not a social media manager. The distinction matters, so here it is plainly:



A social media manager owns a channel. This role owns the founder's throughput. Content is a large part of the work, but it isn't the whole of it. You're the person who takes what's in her head at 9am and has it live, correct, and on-brand by end of day.  Must be an independent thinker.



Skill is required. Execution is the differentiator.



You will work in close, daily contact with the founder. Direction will change and sometimes mid-task. That isn't disorganization; it's what building a public brand looks like from the inside. The right person finds that energizing. The wrong person finds it exhausting, and we'd rather you know that now.  We are growing the brand not maintaining it.  This is an exciting role for someone who loves to get things done.



What you'll own



Execution and operations



- A high daily task load, consistently cleared — not carried forward

- Asana and Notion as living systems: every task updated as it moves, with enough written context that the founder never has to ask where something stands

- End-of-day reports, every day, without being asked. Done / in progress / blocked / needs a decision from the founder.

- Rapid pivots as priorities shift, with the judgment to flag when a pivot creates a conflict rather than silently dropping the previous thing



Content and brand



- Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube are our main platforms (this may expand) You will be responsible for calendar planning, scheduling, publishing

- Presenting plan to founder weekly during meetings

- Short-form video editing with strong hooks and retention-aware pacing

- Feminine, editorial-leaning graphics with a cohesive aesthetic across platforms

- Captions in the founder's voice, not a generic brand voice

- Repurposing single pieces of content into multiple formats across channels

- Community management — warm, professional, on-brand replies to comments and DMs

- Basic performance tracking: what worked, what didn't, what you'd do differently



Who we're looking for



- Highly adaptable. Change is the job. You reorganize around it without needing to be settled first.

- A strong communicator. You over-communicate rather than going quiet. Silence is the only real failure mode here.

- Genuinely organized. Nothing falls through, and nothing lives only in your head.

- Fast and finished. You'd rather ship something 90% right today and refine it than sit on something 100% right next week.

- Available USA EST hours. This is non-negotiable — the role requires real-time responsiveness.

- An eye for feminine luxury. Soft but powerful. Editorial. Elevated without being cold.

- An understanding of storytelling.

- Comfortable with: CapCut Pro, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere or Final Cut a plus)



Bonus if you



- Have worked with beauty, skincare, wellness, or feminine lifestyle brands

- Understand emotional storytelling and how women actually make skincare decisions

- Have supported a founder through a public-facing launch or rebrand



How to apply



 [ADDRESS] with the subject line: IN LOVE WITH SKINCARE



Include:



1. Your resume and experience.

2. Your portfolio — reels, TikToks, graphic design, Instagram feeds, video edits for BEAUTY

3. Links to brands you've worked with and before and afters, when you began working and after you left

4. Details on how many hours you have available

5. 3–5 videos you edited that performed well, and your honest read on why they performed





We also would like to know:



6. Something you've achieved in your personal life recently. Anything at all. Tell us why it mattered to you and why

7. A team you've been part of. What was your actual role on it — not your title, your role.

8. Any awards or recognition you've received, and what you're doing with that now.

9. A time direction changed on you mid-task. What did you do?

10. What beauty brands or creators you find visually excellent, and what makes content feel luxurious rather than expensive.



Lastly please confirm you are comfortable with the rate and your availability during EST hours is aligned.



Include the word Glow somewhere so we know you read all of this.



What happens next



We are moving quickly on this and will begin interviews immediately.



Our team has a lot of heart and we only work alongside people who are kind.  We look forward to meeting you.

title: Elite Acquisitions Closer U.S. Real Estate | Remote | USD Pay
description:
We run a high margin U.S. real estate niche most investors can't touch: partial deeds and title problems. We help families untangle complicated ownership and unlock properties nobody else knows how to close. The deals are unusual, the margins are strong, and the best closer on our team is closing roughly one deal a week.



We're hiring one more sharp closer. The bar is high on purpose.





What This Is





A real sales seat. You research families, get on the phone every day, and build trust with people in hard situations.

This is not a VA role. Not admin. Not "manage a pipeline quietly." You dial, you talk, you move deals.

You'll own leads inside Lofty (our CRM), dial through Dialpad, and pull contacts with SmartSkip.





Your Day





Daily huddle, 10:00 AM ET, cameras on, no exceptions. We review numbers, wins, and blockers together.

75 dials per day minimum, tracked. Your dials, contacts, and conversion are visible to the team every day.

Roughly 40 to 50% research (obituaries, court and tax records, identifying heirs and the real decision maker) and 50 to 60% outreach (calls, texts, voi
s, follow up).

We run a two call close structure. You'll learn it cold.





How We Operate (so you know before you apply)





We track activity daily. If you go dark for a day with no heads up, you won't last here.

We coach hard and expect you to be coachable. B+ players who show up beat A players who don't.

Full training from day one. Clear path to Senior Closer and team lead as you prove out.







What You Need





English at C1/C2 only. Families need to trust your voice on the phone.

5+ years sales experience. Real estate (acquisitions, wholesaling, probate, title) strongly preferred.

Total comfort with daily outbound calling, voi
s, and relentless follow up.

Sharp judgment on who the real decision maker is inside a family.

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, quality headset. Non negotiable.





Schedule





Full time, Monday to Friday

10:00 AM to 7:30 PM Eastern Time





Pay





Base: $1,000 to $1,500 USD per month based on experience

Commission: 10 to 15% depending on deal revenue. Our average deal is over $30,000, so a single close pays well.

Realistic total once ramped: $8,000 per month

Be clear eyed on timing: most reps lock their first deal within 30 days, and commission on that deal pays out around 100 days later once it closes and funds. This niche pays big, but it is not instant money. If you need a paycheck next week, this isn't the seat.







How to Apply



Send a 1 to 2 minute video covering:





Your sales and real estate background

How comfortable you truly are with heavy daily outbound calling

Why you're great at finding and speaking to the right decision maker in a family

Your location and availability

# URGENT HIRING: Marketing Automation, Funnels & Systems Specialist



**Company:** Residual Marketing

**Position:** Marketing Automation, Funnels & Systems Specialist

**Location:** Remote

**Schedule:** Part-time to start

**Growth Opportunity:** Full-time position and pay increase after 30–60 days based on performance and workload

**Start Date:** Immediately



## About the Role



Residual Marketing is urgently hiring a skilled **Marketing Automation, Funnels & Systems Specialist** to build complete automated systems for our agency and every new company we sign as a client.



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to build landing pages, copy workflows, or wait for step-by-step instructions.



We need someone who understands:



* Marketing

* Sales funnels

* Customer journeys

* Business operations

* Lead generation

* Appointment setting

* Follow-up

* Client onboarding

* Project fulfillment

* Automation strategy



The right person must be able to study how a business operates, understand how it makes money, identify gaps in the process, recommend improvements, and build a complete system that helps the company run more efficiently.



We want someone who can bring ideas, suggest better solutions, and add real value.



## Main Systems You Will Use



You will primarily work inside:



* **GoHighLevel**

* **Slack**

* **Timeliner**



Strong GoHighLevel experience is required.

## Marketing and Business Knowledge



This is not only a technical role.



You must understand how marketing and business systems work.



You should understand concepts such as:



* Lead generation

* Sales funnels

* Customer journeys

* Offers

* Lead qualification

* Conversion rates

* “This system could help the company close more business.”



You should not need every small detail explained to you.



You must be able to ask good questions, understand the goal, recommend solutions, and take ownership of the system.



## Example of a Complete Client System

## Required Qualifications

title: Senior Accountant – Canadian Bookkeeping & Close
description:
Location: Philippines (Remote)

Employment Type: Contractor

Band: $1,800–2,200 USD/mo

Working Hours: 9-5:30 EST (Night Shift)

Target: Experienced - Must have Canadian CPA firms experience



Who we are



We’re Concept Accounting & Advisory, a Canadian CPA firm specializing in real estate businesses, brokerages, teams, and property investors across Canada. We’re small, growing fast, and building a modern, tech-driven firm without the corporate layers. We run on QuickBooks Online, Dext, TaxDome, and Microsoft 365.



We’re building our offshore team right now, and we’re hiring the people who grow with us as we scale. If you want to be an early, key member of a team (not employee #97), this is that.



Why join us



- Competitive USD salary, paid twice monthly, reliably and always on time.

- 13th-month bonus, paid mid-year (July), based on performance.

- Annual performance bonus on top of your salary review.

- Two weeks paid vacation, increasing with your tenure.

- Paid December Holiday shutdown.

- Medical coverage after your first year in good standing.

- A real, visible growth path. As we grow our team, you’re first in line to move into a senior/lead role; reviewing others’ work and helping build our offshore function. We hire with that path in mind.

- Direct work with the firm principal (ex-Deloitte) and manager (ex-Canada revenue Agency), your ideas land, no bureaucracy.

- Fully remote, work from your home office.



What you’ll do



- Month-end bookkeeping and close (accrual and cash basis) for multiple clients in QuickBooks Online

- Provide in-depth analysis of client files, identify inaccuracies and inconsistencies, notify clients, and resolve issues independently.

- In-depth review of their clients' month-ends and financial statements (Balance sheet, P&L, aged payables, aged receivables)

- Ensuring clients’ books are kept up-to-date and are accurate and organized, meeting deliverable deadlines.

- Answering more complex bookkeeping-related support questions from clients through Taxdome

- Bank and credit-card reconciliations across client files

- Document and receipt processing in Dext

- Managing multiple clients of varying complexities simultaneously in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment

- Post clear file notes and communicate daily with your manager on Microsoft Teams and Taxdome

- Spot process-improvement and automation opportunities as you learn our systems

- Assist with knowledge sharing and support the company’s growth by preparing and reviewing periodic SOPs, and helping maintain the firm SOP Library in Notion.



Must-have requirements (please don't apply without these)



- At least 2 years inside a CANADIAN accounting firm: we need working knowledge of Canadian GST/HST categorization and CRA processes from day one. (US-only or industry experience does not meet this bar for the senior role.)

- Real, hands-on QuickBooks Online experience as your daily tool: close and reconciliations. (Course/training-only QBO does not qualify — we won't be teaching you the software.)

- Based in the Philippines and able to work the full 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM EST night shift.

- Clear written and spoken English — you'll document work and communicate daily.

- Reliable internet (6 Mbps+ up/down) and a quiet workspace for a full night shift.

- A self-starter who works independently and asks when something’s unclear.



Nice to have (we'll help you grow into these)



- Licensed CPA (Philippines) — active PRC license.

- Experience with Dext and TaxDome.

- 8+ years total accounting experience



Compensation



- $1,800 – $2,200 USD/month, calibrated to your experience and trial results, plus the bonuses and benefits above.



How to apply - please read carefully



We read every application that follows these steps. Ones that skip them, we don’t:



1. Mail your application to 
 with the subject line "Concept Senior – [Your Name] – Night Shift" so we know you read this post.



2. Attach your resume (PDF).



3. State your PRC CPA license status and your years inside a Canadian accounting firm.



4. In 3–4 sentences, describe one QuickBooks Online cleanup or month-end close you personally completed, and what was messy about it.



5. Tell us your current working hours and whether you hold any other ongoing roles right now.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (this is a night shift in the Philippines).



A short paid trial task is part of our process. We’ll walk through your reasoning together on a call.



We are looking for somebody talented and dynamic. We are a growing firm, and the individual who is selected for this position will become a key member of our team!

description:
WEDDING PLANNING ASSISTANT (EXECUTOR & AUDITOR)

Ruban Bleu Weddings & Events



MUST HAVE WEDDING EXPERIENCE. THIS IS NON-NEGOTIABLE.

===============================================



Location: Remote

Hours: 15-20 hours per week

Pay: $6-8 PER HOUR depending on experience

Type: Independent contractor



===============================================



ABOUT RUBAN BLEU WEDDINGS & EVENTS



Ruban Bleu is a wedding and events planning company serving couples across the Dallas-Fort Worth area. We specialize in culturally inclusive celebrations, including Indian and South Asian, Nigerian, Ethiopian, East Asian, Mexican and Latin, Jewish, Middle Eastern, and African American weddings, along with LGBTQ+ weddings, destination weddings, and themed celebrations.



Our mission is to make wedding planning smooth, organized, and stress-free for couples who want a beautifully planned wedding without the luxury price tag.



===============================================



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a Wedding Planning Assistant to serve as our Executor and Auditor. This is the person who owns our project management system as the official record of every wedding, keeps client communication running on schedule, and verifies that the work our contracts promise is actually getting done.



Our operating principle is simple: every task has a doer, a system of record, and a verifier. You are the verifier. "I did it" is a claim. A logged action, a confirmation in hand, or a documented client notification is proof, and only proof closes a task.



This is a detail role for someone who is comfortable checking other people's work, asking direct follow-up questions, and reporting clearly to leadership. This role flags and reports issues. It does not chase or fix them.



The position is fully remote. Strong phone and written communication is essential, since you will be corresponding with clients weekly and verifying vendor communication.



===============================================



RESPONSIBILITIES



SYSTEM OF RECORD

* Build each wedding's task checklist from the signed contract within two days of booking

* Maintain the project management system as the accurate, current record for every active wedding

* Log the outcome of the weekly planner sync, including what was reviewed and what remains outstanding



CLIENT COMMUNICATION

* Draft, format, and send the weekly Friday recap
 to every couple with an active wedding

* Own that the recap actually goes out, on the same day, every week, including quiet weeks

* Send meeting recaps and action items following client calls



AUDITING AND VERIFICATION

* Run a weekly sweep of every active wedding and flag anything overdue, unchecked, or unverified in a standard reporting format

* Run milestone health reviews at 90, 60, and 30 days from each wedding, assigning a status of Green, Yellow, or Red

* Verify that vendor outreach actually occurred by checking
 and call records, rather than accepting that it was done

* Confirm each booked vendor is documented in all three required places

* Check contract scope against package and guest count at booking and again at guest count finalization, flagging any mismatch

* Escalate findings to leadership with the specific gap and a recommended action



CROSS-WEDDING LISTS

* Maintain the coordinator onboarding and HR tracking list

* Maintain the lead pipeline check



===============================================



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to write a clean, professional client
 without heavy editing

* Comfortable and clear on the phone. Customer service, call center, hospitality, front desk, or receptionist experience is a strong plus

* Exceptionally detail-oriented, with the discipline to verify rather than assume

* Comfortable respectfully flagging incomplete work and asking follow-up questions of teammates

* Highly organized and able to manage recurring weekly deadlines without reminders

* Comfortable learning new software and project management platforms

* Reliable and responsive during standard business hours, with some flexibility during wedding season

* Prior experience in weddings, events, hospitality, project coordination, or administrative support preferred



===============================================



WHY JOIN US



You will be part of a small, collaborative team that values clear communication, cultural sensitivity, and doing right by every couple we serve. This role sits at the center of our operation and works directly with the owner, the Operations Manager, and our lead planners.



===============================================

You will handle live chat for Shopify merchants using our apps.



Day to day:



Answer setup and troubleshooting questions

Read screenshots, ask clarifying questions, guide step by step

Sometimes configure rules or settings for a merchant when they are stuck

Explain honestly when something is not possible

Reply in the merchant's language when you can. English is the default

WHAT TYPICAL WORK LOOKS LIKE



Many conversations start simple: merchant opens chat, you ask how you can help.



Then it gets specific. Country-based payment rules. Shipping rate setup. Discount logic not applying. Checkout behavior on certain plans. Billing or uninstall questions. Plan limits. Screenshots back and forth until it is fixed or clearly explained.



Most threads are short to medium length. Some are quick. Some take longer when the merchant is stuck or the store setup is unusual.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must have:

- Excellent written English. Clear, friendly, natural. Not stiff or robotic

- Stable internet, reliable computer, workable home setup

- Comfortable with live chat. Think while typing, stay calm with frustrated merchants

- Honest and direct. You say when something cannot be done instead of guessing

- Willing to learn Shopify admin: payments, shipping, checkout, billing, plans

- Self-starter on a small team



Big plus:

- Prior Shopify experience as merchant, VA, support, or agency staff

- SaaS or app support experience



Not a fit if:

- You only want rigid scripts

- You avoid technical questions

- You need a large corporate structure to function



SCHEDULE



Full-time, remote.



We are moving to shared coverage so shifts are reasonable and sustainable. Expect roughly 8-hour shifts once the team is fully staffed. Exact rotation will be agreed with the team.



Merchants are global, so some weekend or evening coverage may be part of the rotation.



Start: as soon as possible, up to in 3-4 weeks.



COMPENSATION



Competitive monthly rate in USD starting from ~80000 PHP (assuming average performance). Discussed with shortlisted candidates based on experience. Payments via WISE or e-wallet, unless otherwise discussed.



HOW TO APPLY



Send:

- Available timezones you can work in (timeframes)

- CV 

- Answers to all five screening questions below. Copy each question and answer under it. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

- Any additional information you feel is great to share with us



SCREENING QUESTIONS (required)



We use these to filter people who have actually worked with Shopify, not people who guessed or used AI. Be specific. Vague answers get skipped. IMPORTANT: about 90% of candidates were skipped in our previous hiring rounds due to AI generated answers, detected by our systems, or later humans. Do not apply if you don't know what you're doing, you'll be wasting yours and our time. If you really don't know what you're doing and apply using 100% AI generated answers, it will always show up later. 



Question 1: A merchant installs a cash-on-delivery app and says "COD is not showing at checkout." Before you touch anything inside the app, what is the exact click path in Shopify admin to enable Cash on Delivery as a payment method? Write it as steps, like Settings > Payments > ...



Question 2: A COD fee app adds the fee at checkout as a shipping rate, not as a separate line item in the order summary. A merchant asks you to change it to a line item instead. Can a typical COD fee app do that within standard Shopify checkout constraints? Answer yes or no, then explain in 2 to 3 sentences why.



Question 3: A merchant on Shopify Basic wants to install an app that adds a custom banner on the checkout page. Can they use checkout customization apps on Basic? What Shopify plan do they need at minimum, and what Shopify capability unlocks checkout customizations?



Question 4: A merchant wants to hide PayPal for customers in one country but keep it visible in another. Which type of Shopify Function handles this: payment customization, delivery customization, or cart transform? Explain briefly why.



Question 5: A merchant says: "I uninstalled your app but I am still being charged." What do you check first, and what are two common explanations that are not actually a bug in the app?



BONUS (optional): Write your first reply to this merchant message exactly as you would send it in chat:



"Hi, I need help with a payment sorting app. I want cash on delivery first in the list but it stays at the bottom no matter what I do."



Keep it short. Sound human.
salary: starts at ~80000 then up to 250000 PHP

title: Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist for Shopify Fine Jewelry Brand
description:
# Klaviyo
 Marketing Specialist for Shopify Fine Jewelry Brand



## Position Details



**Type of work:** Part-time / Project-Based

**Hours:** Approximately 10–15 hours per week during the initial setup

**Rate:** $10 USD per hour, depending on experience

**Potential:** Long-term ongoing work after the initial project

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability for communication during Israel business hours



## About Us



The Private Room is a family-run fine jewelry boutique based in Tel Aviv, Israel.



We sell fine jewelry, personalized jewelry, Judaica jewelry, diamond pieces and custom-made designs through our Shopify website. Our customers are located in Israel, the United States and other international markets.



We are looking for an experienced **Klaviyo
 Marketing Specialist** to build and organize our complete
 marketing system.



This is not a general virtual-assistant position. We are specifically looking for someone with strong, hands-on experience using **Klaviyo with Shopify e-commerce stores**.



## The Project



Our Shopify store is already connected to Klaviyo, and some basic templates and customer events already exist.



We need someone who can audit the current setup, correct technical issues and build a complete customer lifecycle
 system from signup through repeat purchase and VIP retention.



You will be responsible for both the technical setup and the customer-facing execution.



## Main Responsibilities



### 1. Audit and Technical Setup



* Audit our current Klaviyo account and Shopify integration

* Confirm that all important Shopify events are tracking correctly

* Fix or advise us how to fix product catalog synchronization

* Check Viewed Product, Added to Cart, Checkout Started, Placed Order and Fulfilled Order events

* Correct account settings, including timezone and sending configuration

* Check
 consent, list growth and suppression settings

* Confirm that Shopify and Klaviyo are not sending duplicate abandoned-checkout
s

* Test all dynamic links, product information and checkout recovery links

* Improve
 deliverability and sender-domain setup where necessary



### 2. Build the Core Klaviyo Flows



The initial project should include:



* Welcome Series

* Browse Abandonment

* Added-to-Cart Abandonment

* Abandoned Checkout

* First-Time Customer Post-Purchase

* Returning Customer Post-Purchase

* Order Fulfillment Follow-Up

* Jewelry Care

* Product Review Request

* Cross-Sell and Upsell

* Back-in-Stock

* Win-Back

* VIP Customer

* Sunset and Re-Engagement

* Birthday and Anniversary

* Bespoke Jewelry or Private Appointment Lead Follow-Up



Each flow must include the correct:



* Trigger

* Timing and delays

* Flow filters

* Conditional splits

* Exit conditions

* Smart Sending settings

* Customer segmentation

* Purchase and engagement exclusions



Customers must automatically leave cart, checkout or browse flows once they complete a purchase.



### 3.
 Copywriting and Design



* Write clear, elegant and conversion-focused
 copy

* Maintain a refined, personal and luxury tone

* Avoid aggressive or overly promotional language

* Build mobile-friendly
s inside Klaviyo

* Use our existing brand style and Shopify imagery

* Create clear calls to action

* Use dynamic product images and customer information where appropriate

* Create subject lines and preview text

* Include proper unsubscribe and compliance elements

* Separate marketing
s from transactional order communication



The design should feel like a private fine-jewelry boutique—not a generic dropshipping or discount-store template.



### 4. Segmentation and Personalization



Create useful customer segments, including:



* Subscribers who have never purchased

* First-time customers

* Repeat customers

* VIP and high-value customers

* Engaged subscribers

* Unengaged subscribers

* Customers interested in necklaces, bracelets, rings or personalized jewelry

* High-intent browsers

* Abandoned carts and checkouts

* Bespoke-jewelry leads

* Israeli customers

* International customers

* Customers who purchased Judaica or personalized jewelry



Use conditional splits when new customers, returning customers and high-value customers should receive different communication.



### 5. Welcome Offer and Coupons



* Set up our first-purchase welcome offer

* Confirm that the discount is limited to eligible customers

* Recommend whether we should use a fixed code or unique single-use Shopify discount codes

* Prevent existing customers from repeatedly receiving first-purchase discounts

* Test discount links and checkout behavior



### 6. Testing and Quality Assurance



Before any flow is activated, you must:



* Test every
 on desktop and mobile

* Check all links

* Test personalization variables

* Test dynamic Shopify product information

* Confirm flow filters and conditional splits

* Check that customers stop receiving recovery
s after purchasing

* Review spelling, grammar and formatting

* Send test
s for approval

* Receive our approval before changing any flow to Live



Nothing should be activated without our review and approval.



### 7. Reporting and Documentation



At the end of the project, provide:



* A document listing every flow created

* The purpose and trigger of each flow

* Timing between
s

* Filters and conditional splits used

* A list of segments created

* Any Shopify or Klaviyo issues that still require attention

* Recommendations for future campaigns

* A simple monthly reporting template

* A short screen-recorded walkthrough of the account



## Required Experience



You must have:



* Proven hands-on experience with Klaviyo

* Experience integrating and managing Klaviyo with Shopify

* Experience building complete e-commerce lifecycle flows

* Strong written English

*
 copywriting experience

*
 design and layout experience

* Strong knowledge of segmentation and personalization

* Experience with dynamic Shopify product blocks

* Experience testing flow logic and event data

* Understanding of
 deliverability

* Ability to work independently and communicate clearly



Experience with luxury, jewelry, fashion, beauty or other premium e-commerce brands is highly preferred.



## This Role Is Not Suitable For



Please do not apply if:



* You are primarily a general virtual assistant

* You have only used Mailchimp or Shopify

* You have never built Klaviyo flows yourself

* You rely entirely on generic templates or AI-generated copy

* You cannot provide examples of previous Klaviyo work

* You only design
s but cannot configure triggers, filters and conditional logic

* You only configure flows but cannot write or improve the
 content



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the word **DIAMOND** so we know you have read the complete job description.



Please include all of the following:



1. A short introduction explaining your Klaviyo and Shopify experience

2. Links or screenshots showing at least two Klaviyo flows you personally built

3. An example of an
 you wrote and designed

4. One or two measurable results you achieved, such as flow revenue, click rate, conversion rate or revenue per recipient

5. Your hourly rate

6. Your weekly availability

7. Your estimated time to complete the initial setup

8. A short Loom or video introduction of no more than three minutes



Please also answer these questions:



* Which Klaviyo flow would you prioritize first for a fine-jewelry Shopify store, and why?

* What filters should be used to stop an abandoned-checkout flow after a customer purchases?

* How would you treat a $10,000 abandoned checkout differently from a $500 abandoned checkout?

* How would you diagnose a Shopify store where Added to Cart is tracking but Viewed Product is not?

* What information would you need from us before beginning the project?



Applications that do not begin with **DIAMOND** or do not include examples of previous Klaviyo work will not be considered.



## Our Ideal Candidate



The right person is detail-oriented, proactive and able to combine technical Klaviyo knowledge with good judgment and elegant communication.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the complete setup, explain their decisions clearly and help us turn
 marketing into a professional long-term sales and customer-retention channel.



There is potential for ongoing work managing campaigns, testing flows, analyzing results and improving performance after the initial project is completed.

 is a new SaaS platform designed for restaurants. I am a solo US-based developer building the product from scratch, and I am looking for a confident salesperson to help introduce it to restaurant owners.

Each commission is paid once per restaurant. You will be responsible for finding and developing your own leads.



Someone who produces exceptional results may be offered a much larger role, including management of future sales representatives and a formal profit-sharing partnership. I am willing to discuss sharing a substantial percentage of the project’s profits, potentially up to 50%, with someone who proves they can build and lead the sales operation.

 outreach

title: Direct-Response Video Editor — Short-Form + VSL Ads (UGC / Story / Animation / Native)
description:
We're a story-driven DTC brand hiring a direct-response editor to cut ads for
, Instagram, and TikTok. One brand, long-term, real room to grow with us.



Read this before applying, because it's the whole job:



We are not hiring a videographer. We're hiring an editor who thinks like a marketer. Your work is judged on one thing — did the ad stop the scroll and hold it — not on how cinematic it looks. Clarity beats cleverness. We chase response, not aesthetics. If your instinct with raw footage is to color-grade it, add slick transitions, and "clean it up," we're not a fit — and that's okay.



What you'll actually be cutting

Ads that feel like a real person posted them, not like a brand ran them — UGC-style testimonials, emotional story ads, animation ads, VSLs, AI-voiceover + b-roll ads, text-on-screen ads, native creatives, hooks, product demos. Raw and real beats polished, every time. The goal is to not make it look like an ad.



The craft we expect (this is the standard, not a wishlist)

You understand concepts, not just cuts. You get the idea behind an ad — the angle, the belief it shifts, the emotional arc — and you edit to serve it. You can tell why an ad works, second by second, not just that it "looks clean."

You're not tied to one format — you can build whatever the concept needs. UGC testimonial, story ad, VSL, AI-voiceover-over-b-roll, text-on-screen, split-screen, before/after, static-to-video, animation. You pick the format that serves the idea and you can cut all of them well.

Animation ads. You can build animated story ads and simple 3D/animated explainers that make an invisible mechanism visible — showing the viewer what's happening so the idea lands instantly.

Hook in the first 3 seconds. A pattern interrupt that stops the scroll — never a logo or a polite intro. You understand open loops and curiosity gaps and use them to buy the next second.

Retention over everything. Every second earns the next. You cut to an emotional arc — relatability ? tension ? relief — not to a checklist of clips.

You use contrast to control the eye. Black-and-white with a single accent color, before/after, tension into relief, loud into quiet — visual and emotional contrast to pull attention exactly where it needs to go.

B-roll that matches the voiceover word-for-word, and clean text-on-screen that carries the message with the sound off (feeds autoplay muted). Clips run ~3–5s, natural light, no staged studio look, product revealed late — after the story earns it, never up front.

Sound design as timing, not decoration. Music, zoom, and SFX move with the emotion — the track shifts at each structural beat, the zoom lands on the emphasis line, the punch hits on the reveal.

Keep UGC raw. Slightly awkward, imperfect, conversational — that's the authenticity that converts. Don't polish it out.

Native by default: 9:16 vertical, tight or long depending on the concept, fast clean captions/subtitles, no watermarks or bugs.

Tools & workflow

Editing: Premiere / CapCut / Final Cut — whatever you're fastest and sharpest in. We care about output, not software.

Claude is our brain for everything, and it's a big plus if you already work in it: scripts, natural-speech conversion, creative briefs, ad breakdowns, and second-by-second teardowns all run through Claude. The more fluent you are with it, the faster you'll move.

Plus whatever helps you execute better — AI voiceover (ElevenLabs), AI animation/video generation (Kling, Seedance), and spy research on the Meta Ad Library / AdSpy to study winners and losers. Show us the tools that make you faster and sharper.

You'll live in the research loop: study winners and losers, break them down beat-by-beat, form a hypothesis, iterate fast. You're expected to have opinions on why an ad worked — not just assemble footage.

What we provide

Raw footage, scripts and hooks, creative direction, winning-ad examples, and our internal training so you learn our exact style and keep getting better.



What you keep

Base pay plus a performance bonus on every winning ad you cut. The better your ads convert, the more you make.



How to apply (read carefully — incomplete applications are skipped)

This is the filter, on purpose. Do all three or we move on:



1. Portfolio of real DR ads. 3–5 actual ads you cut — UGC, story, VSL, animation, text-on-screen, whatever you're strongest at — vertical, native, made to sell. No wedding videos, no YouTube intros, no cinematic reels, no motion-graphics showreels. If your best work is polished brand films, we're not your brand.



2. Pick a winning ad you admire (any brand) and tell us, in one paragraph, why it works — second by second. Hook, why it holds, where the emotion turns. We're reading for whether you think in concepts and retention or just "nice edits."



3. Answer this: You get raw phone footage of a customer talking about our product — a little awkward, natural light, not "produced." Do you (a) polish it into a clean cinematic testimonial, or (b) keep it raw and slightly imperfect — and why?



Bonus if you've edited ecommerce ads before, can move between formats (UGC, VSL, animation, text-on-screen), work in Claude, communicate clearly, and turn revisions around fast.

title: YouTube Content Production Assistant (Long-Term, Growing Role)
description:
We run a growing network of YouTube channels in the cars and motorcycles niche, producing 100+ videos per month. As the network grows, this role grows with it. You will start with two clearly defined tasks, every working day:



1. Create voiceovers. You will generate the voiceover for each video using our AI voice tool, with our exact settings, and check the audio before delivery: no mispronounced model names, no weird numbers, no glitches. We will teach you the entire process; no audio experience needed.

2. Check scripts. Before a script goes to production, you check it against our written checklist: correct units, correct structure, our formatting rules followed, obvious errors flagged. You do not rewrite anything; you catch what breaks the rules and report it.



What we are looking for: someone precise, consistent and coachable. Both tasks are fully teachable in the first week, and you will be trained directly by our channel manager. What we cannot teach is care: this job is for someone who genuinely notices when something is slightly off.



Experience that is a plus:



Working on YouTube channels or other content production (uploads, editing support, channel operations)

Proofreading, QA, or any job where your role was catching other people's mistakes

AI tools: text-to-speech or voice generation tools, ChatGPT, Claude or others

Knowledge of cars or motorcycles (you will spot a mispronounced model name much faster)

Remote VA experience with daily deliverables for one long-term client



You are a fit if:



You are obsessively detail-oriented. A mispronounced bike name in a finished voiceover would genuinely bother you

You are consistent: work every working day, communicate when something changes, never just disappear

You read English carefully (our scripts are English, US market)

You follow written instructions exactly, every time

You want stable, long-term work with one team



The offer:



Part-time to start: 20 hours per week, growing into full-time as the network expands

$150/month, paid weekly during the first month

Consistent daily workload

Full training in week one, direct daily contact with our channel manager

Long-term: the network is growing and we promote from inside



To apply, follow these three steps exactly. Applications that miss any step are not read.



1. Type the word SPROCKET in capital letters as the very first line of your application, before anything else. This is how we know you read the full post.

2. Four of our script rules are: all units must be US units (miles, pounds, dollars); scripts never use the em dash character; every video intro must be under 60 words; prices are always exact ranges, never the word "around". Here is a script fragment. Tell me every rule violation you find:

"The Kawasaki Vulcan S weighs 226 kilograms and sells for around four thousand dollars. It is the perfect first cruiser for a returning rider, and the low seat means almost anyone can plant both feet flat at a stoplight."

3. Tell me your available working hours in Amsterdam time, and whether you have other clients.

1. The Golden Rule

Definition: Treat others as you would like to be treated.

How We Live It: We treat our janitor the same way we treat our CEO. Everyone deserves respect, kindness, and fairness. Whether it’s a teammate, a vendor, or a customer, we believe in treating others as we would treat our own grandmother—with care, patience, and sincerity.

Our service timelines align with your needs—whether it's a quick turnaround for a COI or a thorough annual review of your policies. With us, you get quality protection that lasts.

title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 400+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data entry role. You're the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate and flags problems before they cost us time and money. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don't let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

Schedule & Work Setup

What You'll Get

Who Thrives Here

title: GoHighLevel & Full-Stack Web Systems Specialist
description:
Project Driver LLC (Fort Lauderdale, FL) builds marketing and automation systems for US home-services businesses. The company is founder-led by an engineer and runs on requirements-first, test-everything, document-everything.



THE MISSION

The number one job here is simple to say and hard to do: bring in traffic and turn it into conversions, in a repeatable manner. Everything else is a tool for that. The right person understands the whole chain from search result to booked job, and treats anything that doesn't move that chain as a distraction.



THE ROLE

One long-term seat. Starting hours to be determined with the selected candidate, with room to grow into a full-time exclusive position.



SCHEDULE

Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST, slight variance depending on project needs. Slightly modified hours can be discussed for the right candidate after proven success.



THE WORK

GoHighLevel: snapshots, workflows, pipelines, calendars, forms, A2P 10DLC, Conversation AI, integrations (n8n, Zapier, webhooks, APIs). Follow-up automations and lead routing that make sense, and attention to what's converting; so the stuff that isn't gets fixed.



WordPress: Elementor, Gutenberg, Rank Math, LiteSpeed, mobile QA, wiring GHL funnels and forms into WP so leads land somewhere. Pages built to convert, not just look good.



SEO: The whole picture. Technical (crawl issues, redirects, Core Web Vitals, site structure), on-page (content, schema, internal links), off-page (links, citations), local through national (GBP, map pack, service-area and multi-location work). Google changes, AI search changes, social feeds into it. Keeping up is part of the job.



Server-side: PHP fixes and small custom builds, cPanel, DNS, SSL, migrations, staging on reseller hosting. All the unglamorous work that keeps the rest running smoothly.



Honesty over everything. Nobody's an expert in all of this on day one. Gaps get trained for the right hire. What's expected is a straight answer on what you can do today versus what you're still learning. "Not yet" is respected. A bluff gets caught, and trust is what we're built on.



WHO THRIVES HERE

This seat runs without supervision. Whoever sits in it owns the work, they're responsible for it, they lead it, and they answer for it. That means dependable and reachable during working hours, no chasing, no radio silence. It means owning a problem until it's solved, researching before asking, and pushing projects forward without being pushed. And it means bringing better ways of working (faster, higher quality) before anyone asks.



NON-NEGOTIABLES

Attention to detail. Everything gets tested before handover, every time.

Communication. Clear progress updates, questions asked early, never radio silence.

Requirements confirmed before building. Documentation good enough that someone else could run it.

Team player, not a yes-man. If the plan has a hole in it, say so and provide a solution.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Describe one automation or build you did end-to-end: the requirement, what broke or almost broke, how you fixed it and documented it.

2. Describe one thing you built that produced traffic, leads, or conversions. What you did, and what happened after.

3. In your own words, one sentence: what does "a site that ranks but doesn't convert" mean to you? Do not use the words "traffic," "funnel," or "optimize" in your answer.

4. For each area under THE WORK, one honest sentence: what you've actually done, or "not yet."

5. Start your application with the word FLYWHEEL. Applications are read by a human who has seen thousands of these. Generic, AI-drafted, or template answers are obvious and get rejected unread.

6. Explain your hands-on experience with each of the following, one line each: A2P 10DLC registration, Conversation AI, workflow webhooks, and GHL's cadence mirror feature.

7. Describe a time you kept a project moving when nobody was checking on you, or when something kept failing and you didn't quit.

8. Provide a live intro video of yourself.

9. Link anything real that you've created: live site, portfolio, case study, GitHub, etc.

title: Client Account & Project Manager
description:
Client Account & Project Manager



Location: Remote — work from anywhere, with at least three hours’ overlap with UK working hours from 9amType of work: Full-timeHours: 40 hours per weekSalary: £1,000 GBP per monthStart date: Immediate



About Candid Founders



At Candid Founders, we’re the team behind one of the fastest-growing wholesale brands on Faire. We’ve grown our own brand to more than 1,000 wholesale stockists and now help other product-based businesses do the same.



From optimising Faire accounts to improving retailer engagement and exploring international distribution, we’ve developed a proven wholesale growth playbook that helps brands move from ticking over to becoming category leaders.



About the Role



We’re looking for an organised, commercially minded Client Account & Project Manager to help manage and grow our clients’ wholesale accounts.



This is a varied, hands-on role combining client success, account management, SEO,
 marketing and wholesale operations. You might spend one day reviewing a client’s account and identifying growth opportunities, the next improving product listings and writing an
 campaign, and the next helping a client prepare for a new product launch.



You’ll take ownership of the day-to-day progress of several client accounts, working closely with our founders, clients and specialist tea
mbers to ensure priorities are clear and work is delivered to a high standard.



This isn’t a traditional account management position where you simply pass messages between clients and the delivery team. You’ll be expected to understand each client’s business, spot opportunities and help turn recommendations into measurable progress.



Key Responsibilities



Client Account Management



Manage multiple client accounts, keeping priorities, deadlines and deliverables organised.



Support the onboarding of new clients and map out their initial account optimisation and growth priorities.



Maintain clear action plans and ensure agreed work progresses on time.



Communicate regularly with clients, founders and internal tea
mbers.



Prepare client updates, reports and recommendations clearly.



Build strong client relationships and give clients confidence that their accounts are moving forward.



Our clients are all based in the USA and will be managed by a USA based account Director, who you will work closely with. 



Account Audits and Growth Planning



Conduct detailed wholesale account reviews and identify areas for improvement.



Turn account data and observations into practical, prioritised recommendations.



Identify opportunities to increase visibility, conversion, retailer engagement and repeat orders.



Help address operational issues such as late shipments, incomplete listings or underperforming products.



Recommend improvements to product presentation, imagery, pricing and account structure.



Research additional growth opportunities, including retailer outreach, new marketplaces and distributor partnerships.



SEO and Listing Optimisation



Optimise product names, descriptions, categories and brand profiles for search visibility and conversion.



Research and implement relevant keywords and search terms.



Update and maintain product listings, including descriptions, pricing, photographs and videos.



Ensure listings are accurate, consistent and aligned with each client’s brand voice.



Track SEO and listing performance and share useful insights with clients and the wider team.



 Marketing and Buyer Engagement



Write and schedule regular
 campaigns designed to drive wholesale orders and reorders.



Adapt messaging to reflect each client’s tone of voice.



Use customer segmentation and messaging strategy to improve engagement and retailer loyalty.



Create clear, persuasive copy and simple supporting visuals.



Engage with retailers through Faire Messenger and other relevant communication channels.



Support the creation and improvement of automated
 flows where appropriate.



 Marketing Support



Draft client case studies and success stories that demonstrate results.



Capture client wins and useful insights that can support Candid Founders’ wider marketing activity.



What You’ll Bring



No experience is required, just brilliant, hard working people wanted



Strong organisation and attention to detail.



Excellent written English. 



Strong verbal communication and confidence working directly with clients and founders.



The ability to manage several client accounts and competing priorities simultaneously.



A proactive, problem-solving mindset—you notice opportunities and take ownership of moving them forward.



The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team.



Comfort learning new systems, processes and ecommerce platforms.



A genuine interest in helping product-based businesses grow.



Nice to Have



Previous experience working in an agency.



Experience managing ecommerce or wholesale marketplace accounts.



Familiarity with platforms such as Faire, Abound or Handshake.



Experience writing and managing
 campaigns or automated
 flows.



Basic experience creating
 or account visuals.



One to two years’ experience in account management, SEO,
 marketing, ecommerce operations, digital marketing or a similar role is nice to have but not necessary. 



Practical experience with SEO optimisation, keyword research and performance analysis.



Experience communicating directly with retailers or ecommerce clients.



Direct Faire experience is helpful, but it isn’t essential. We’re more interested in your ability to write well, stay organised, understand account performance and turn ideas into action.



Why You’ll Love Working With Us



Work directly with founders Andy and Lucy and learn the playbook we’ve used to grow wholesale businesses at different stages.



Support businesses ranging from start ups to businesses doing over $500m per year



Receive hands-on training in our Wholesale Growth Framework, covering account operations, SEO, retailer engagement, reorders and scaling.



Work remotely with flexible hours outside the required UK overlap.



Take on a varied role where no two weeks look the same.



Have genuine ownership and the opportunity to shape how we support our clients.



Follow a clear progression path as our client roster and team continue to grow.



Receive 28 days of paid annual leave, plus an additional paid day off for your birthday.



How to Apply



Complete our application form here:

title: Property Operations, AI & Process Improvement Virtual Assistant
description:
Property Operations, AI & Process Improvement Virtual Assistant

Part-Time Position With Opportunity to Grow to Full-Time



Steadvera Group is seeking a highly organized, analytical and technology-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our growing real-estate, furnished-rental, asset-management and consulting operations.



This position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week at $5 USD per hour. For the right person, the position is intended to grow into a stable 30- to 40-hour-per-week long-term role.



This is not a basic data-entry position. We need someone who can manage detailed assignments while also thinking critically, solving problems, analyzing information, conducting research and recommending practical solutions.



The successful candidate will support several areas:



Short-term and mid-term rental operations

Property launch and project coordination

Booking and calendar administration

Financial and accounting administration

Tax-strategy documentation coordination

Artificial intelligence and automation

Website updates and digital support

Lean manufacturing and Operational Excellence projects

Root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving

Data analysis, reporting and savings tracking



The person selected will coordinate and support operations but will not have final executive authority. Final business, legal, tax, contractual and financial decisions will remain with the owner or an authorized family leadership representative.



Primary Responsibilities

Property Launch and Project Coordination

Build and maintain the Steadvera Property Launch Master Plan.

Create separate launch checklists for each property and rental unit.

Track furniture, appliances, supplies, utilities, internet, smart locks, security systems, photography, inspections, listings and launch dates.

Convert instructions into clear tasks with an owner, priority, due date and status.

Follow up on overdue assignments.

Identify risks, missing information and tasks that could delay a property launch.

Maintain a master dashboard covering all properties and business entities.

Prepare a weekly status report showing completed work, open tasks, overdue items, risks and decisions needed from the owner.

Short-Term and Mid-Term Rental Operations

Support the administration of short-term and mid-term furnished rental properties.

Maintain accurate booking, occupancy and guest records.

Coordinate availability across Airbnb, Furnished Finder, direct bookings and other platforms.

Immediately block unavailable dates on all applicable calendars after a reservation is confirmed.

Review calendars for overlapping reservations and double-booking risks.

Track inquiries, reservations, extensions, cancellations, arrivals and departures.

Coordinate cleaning, inspection and maintenance schedules around guest stays.

Maintain records of average nightly rates, monthly rates, average length of stay, occupancy and booking lead time.

Assist with the setup and administration of property-management software or a channel manager.



Experience with Airbnb, Furnished Finder, hospitality, corporate housing, short-term rentals or mid-term rentals is strongly preferred.



Property Listings and Guest Communications

Create, upload, review and update furnished-rental listings.

Review property descriptions, titles, amenities, photographs, fees, house rules and local-area information.

Research listing keywords and ways to improve booking visibility.

Draft professional guest messages for inquiries, confirmations, check-in, check-out, extensions, maintenance concerns and payment reminders.

Maintain approved guest-message templates.

Identify situations that require owner review or approval.

Pricing and Market Research

Research local peak seasons and demand patterns.

Maintain a calendar of graduations, festivals, sporting events, holidays, conferences, hospital demand, corporate projects and other events affecting rental demand.

Review comparable furnished rental listings.

Track competitor pricing, amenities, availability, fees and minimum-stay requirements.

Analyze occupancy, booking lead time, nightly rates and length of stay.

Prepare recommendations for peak-season pricing, weekday and weekend rates, extended-stay discounts, opening promotions and minimum-stay requirements.

Support all recommendations with clear facts and data.

Obtain owner approval before making significant pricing changes.

Cleaning, Maintenance and Vendor Coordination

Maintain an organized directory of cleaners, contractors, maintenance technicians, landscapers and other vendors.

Schedule cleaning, inspection, repair and maintenance appointments.

Confirm appointments and follow up until work is completed.

Collect invoices, receipts, photographs and completion documentation.

Maintain an open work-order tracker.

Escalate urgent property, guest, safety, electrical, plumbing, security or HVAC issues.

Identify repeated problems that may require root-cause analysis.

Inventory and Inspection Management

Maintain a room-by-room inventory for each property.

Track furniture, appliances, electronics, linens, kitchen supplies, bathroom supplies, décor, safety equipment and consumable supplies.

Record purchase dates, costs, warranties, model numbers and serial numbers when available.

Maintain turnover and inspection checklists.

Review inspection reports and photographs.

Identify missing, damaged, worn or low-stock items.

Prepare purchasing and replenishment recommendations.

Track recurring damages, shortages or replacement needs.

Tenant Billing and Accounts Receivable

Review utility bills for a long-term rental property.

Calculate amounts tenants are required to reimburse.

Prepare monthly tenant invoices for owner approval.

Prepare and track a $300 administrative fee associated with adding another occupant to a lease.

Track invoice dates, due dates, payments and outstanding balances.

Maintain supporting documentation and tenant correspondence.

Send approved invoices and payment reminders.

Escalate overdue balances or disputes to the owner.

Finance and Accounting Administration



A finance, accounting, bookkeeping or business background is strongly preferred.



Responsibilities may include:



Organizing income and expense records

Coding expenses by property, company, vendor and category

Maintaining accounts-payable and accounts-receivable trackers

Matching receipts to transactions

Identifying missing receipts or documentation

Organizing bank and credit-card reconciliation packages

Preparing property-level financial summaries

Comparing budgeted costs with actual costs

Tracking furnishing, launch and operating expenses

Tracking booking-platform payouts and fees

Preparing occupancy, revenue, expense and cash-flow reports

Coordinating with the company’s bookkeeper, accountant and tax professionals



The candidate should understand basic concepts such as revenue, operating expenses, capital expenditures, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash flow, profit and loss, net operating income, return on investment and break-even analysis.



Experience with QuickBooks Online, Stessa, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets or similar financial systems is preferred.



Tax-Strategy Documentation Coordination



The company will work with qualified accountants, CPAs, attorneys and tax professionals to evaluate and implement approved real-estate tax strategies.



The Virtual Assistant will not provide tax or legal advice. The assistant will coordinate the administrative documentation needed by the owner and professional advisors.



Responsibilities may include:



Maintaining a tax-strategy action tracker

Recording recommendations received from qualified professionals

Converting approved recommendations into tasks and deadlines

Coordinating documentation requested by the CPA or accountant

Organizing property closing statements and purchase documents

Tracking property placed-in-service dates

Organizing furniture, appliance, renovation and improvement invoices

Maintaining fixed-asset and purchase records

Organizing mortgage interest, property tax, insurance and utility records

Maintaining reservation histories and average-length-of-stay reports

Maintaining owner participation and property-activity logs when directed

Coordinating cost-segregation documents

Collecting year-end booking-platform statements

Identifying missing documentation

Preparing organized document packages for the accountant or CPA

Following up on outstanding questions and action items



The assistant must understand the difference between organizing tax documentation and providing tax advice. Final classifications, elections, deductions and tax decisions must be made by qualified professionals.



Artificial Intelligence and Automation



Strong experience using artificial intelligence tools is preferred.



Responsibilities may include:



Using ChatGPT and other approved AI tools for research, drafting, summaries, data organization, property descriptions, spreadsheet formulas and report preparation

Creating reusable prompts and AI-assisted workflows

Verifying AI-generated information before it is used

Identifying repetitive work that could be automated

Creating templates, checklists, forms and standard operating procedures

Documenting workflows so they can be repeated consistently

Protecting confidential information and following company rules regarding AI use



Applicants should be prepared to explain which AI tools they have used and provide examples of how they used them to improve productivity.



Website and Digital Support

Assist with updates to company and property webpages.

Add or revise approved text, photographs, FAQs, property details and local-area information.

Review webpages for broken links, outdated information, missing content, formatting problems and spelling errors.

Review webpages for mobile presentation and ease of use.

Maintain a website-change tracker.

Coordinate updates with the company’s web designer.

Assist with basic search-engine optimization and keyword research.

Support landing pages, contact forms and property-information pages.



Experience with WordPress, Wix, Squarespace or similar platforms is preferred. Basic HTML or CSS knowledge is helpful but not required.



Lean Manufacturing, Engineering and Operational Excellence Support



Experience supporting manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply-chain, continuous-improvement or Operational Excellence teams is strongly preferred.



Assignments may include:



Maintaining Lean Six Sigma and continuous-improvement project trackers

Organizing plant-level savings projects and action plans

Tracking project targets, actual performance, forecasts and validated savings

Preparing project charters, timelines and executive summaries

Maintaining DMAIC documentation

Cleaning, organizing and validating operational data

Preparing charts, dashboards, Pareto analyses and trend summaries

Creating process maps and SIPOC diagrams

Supporting A3 problem-solving documentation

Maintaining corrective-action trackers

Tracking risks, countermeasures, owners and due dates

Preparing meeting notes and action-item reports

Following up with project-tea
mbers

Preparing PowerPoint presentations and Excel reports

Supporting return-on-investment, payback and cost-benefit calculations

Distinguishing estimated savings from implemented and financially validated savings

Identifying missing data, inconsistencies and unsupported assumptions

Researching manufacturing technologies and process-improvement opportunities



Applicants are not expected to independently solve complex technical engineering problems. However, they must be able to understand instructions, analyze data, ask intelligent questions and organize technical information accurately.



Root-Cause Analysis and Structured Problem-Solving



The successful candidate must be able to investigate problems rather than simply report them.



The candidate should be able to:



Define a problem clearly

Gather relevant information and data

Separate facts from assumptions

Identify possible causes

Determine the most likely root cause

Recommend corrective and preventive actions

Follow up to verify whether the solution worked

Document lessons learned



Experience with several of the following tools is strongly preferred:



5 Whys

Pareto analysis

Process mapping

SIPOC

Value-stream mapping

FMEA

PDCA

DMAIC

A3 problem solving

Kaizen

5S

Standard work

Risk assessment

Control plans

KPI dashboards

Waste and cost reduction

Productivity analysis

Downtime analysis

Quality improvement

Cost-benefit and return-on-investment analysis



Formal Lean Six Sigma certification is helpful but not required.



Required Qualifications

Strong written and spoken English

Excellent reading comprehension

Excellent organization and attention to detail

Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills

Ability to investigate issues and recommend solutions

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills

Ability to use formulas, filters, conditional formatting and pivot tables

Ability to organize and analyze business data

Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools

Ability to verify AI-generated information

Strong online research skills

Experience with project-management software

Professional written communication

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

Ability to work independently

title: Shopify Store Growth Operator| Beauty, Health, Wellness and Fitness Brand | Private Label Product Research to Scaled Ads
description:
**Ecommerce Growth Operator | Beauty, Health, Wellness and Fitness Brand | Private Label Product Research to Scaled Ads**



---



We are building a private label beauty, health, wellness, and fitness ecommerce brand, starting with one hero product and scaling into a full brand portfolio over time. We need someone who can own the entire process from product research to a live, selling store under our own brand name. Not someone who waits for direction. Someone who has done this before and can do it again, faster and better.



This is not a task based VA role. This is an operator role. You will start from zero, find the winning product yourself, source a supplier who can private label it under our brand, build the store yourself, launch the ads yourself, and scale what works.



---



**Why private label matters here**

We are not building a one time dropship test. We are building brand equity we can own, protect margin on, and scale into a real portfolio. That only works if the product carries our name, our packaging, and our identity from day one, not a generic version anyone else can sell too.



---



**What success looks like**

A validated hero product with a live, fully built Shopify store within the first few days of starting. First sales within the first two weeks. From there, a clear kill or scale decision backed by real data, and 
ntum toward testing the next product in the portfolio.



---



**What you will actually be doing**



You will research products in the beauty, health, wellness, and fitness space using more than one method, not just one tool. You are validating real demand through revenue data, active ad counts, ad run duration, and competition levels before a single product moves forward.



Once you find a winning concept you will find and vet a supplier who can manufacture or package it under our brand, negotiate minimum order quantities, and build a relationship you can depend on long term.



You will build a dedicated Shopify store around that product fast. Premium theme, conversion focused landing page, bundle pricing, and trust elements that make a stranger feel safe buying from a brand they have never heard of.



Before anything goes live you set up tracking properly.
 Business Manager, pixel installation, event verification, and a secondary attribution tool to cross check your data.



Then you launch. You test with a small structured budget, monitor daily performance signals, and make kill or scale decisions based on the numbers. Once a product wins you manage it ongoing while starting research on the next one.



---



**Tools you need to have real experience with**



For product research: Kalodata, PiPiAds,
 Ads Library, and organic TikTok scrolling to catch what is trending before it shows up in the data tools. We want someone who cross references multiple sources, not someone relying on one tool alone.



For store building: Shopify and premium conversion focused themes such as Shrine or Elixir, or a close equivalent.



For tracking and ads:
 Business Manager including pixel setup and event verification, plus a secondary independent attribution tool such as WeTrack or similar.



For conversion and retention: bundle pricing apps such as Kaching Bundle, and subscription apps such as Loop Subscription, or close equivalents.



For creative: Canva and AI image tools such as Midjourney or Adobe Firefly.



For daily workflow: AI assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude.



If you have used a direct equivalent to any tool listed, tell us specifically which one and how it compares.



Start your application with the word "HERO" so we know you read this in full. Right after that, in your first line, tell us how many products you typically need to test to find one validated winner, based on your own experience.

---



**Trial period and working hours**



This role starts with a 30 day paid trial. The purpose is simple, we want to see real execution and reliability before committing long term, not just a good interview.



During the trial your working hours need to be 7 PM to 1 AM CDT so we can collaborate and communicate in real time. Communication will be in Slack throughout.



If the PAID trial goes well, we move into a long term role, full time or part time depending on what you are looking for, with a base rate plus performance upside tied to the sales you generate.



---



**You are the right person if**



You have personally researched and validated a product before spending money on it, using more than one method. You have found and vetted a supplier for private label manufacturing, not just dropshipping. You have built a Shopify store from scratch fast, without needing a template handed to you. You have launched and managed Meta ad campaigns and can walk us through what happened. You can commit to the 7 PM to 1 AM CDT schedule for the full trial period. You move fast and do not need constant supervision once you understand the standards.



---



**You are not the right fit if**



You have never done product research on your own. You have never built a Shopify store independently. You have no private label sourcing experience, only basic dropshipping. You have never managed a live ad account with real budget. You cannot commit to the trial hours. You need heavy hand holding to get started.



---



**How to apply**



Do not just tell us you can do this. Show us.



Submit a short plan for how you would approach your first product test with us, from research through to launch, including which tools you would use at each step and your estimated timeline to get a store live and ads running.



Walk us through a product you personally researched and validated before, including what data convinced you it was worth testing.



Tell us about a private label supplier relationship you built and how you managed it.



Walk us through a Shopify store you built from scratch, including the theme you used.



Tell us which attribution tool you use alongside
 Ads Manager and why.



Share a Meta ad campaign you ran, the budget, and what happened.



Applications that copy and paste generic experience will not be considered. Applications that show a real plan and real process will get a fast response.

, Instagram, and paid advertising platforms. The right person must know how to create designs that capture attention, increase engagement, communicate clearly, and motivate people to attend events.

* Coordinating technicians and ensuring jobs are completed efficiently

Requirements

Schedule

The position generally requires:

The Type of Person Who Will Succeed

If you enjoy taking responsibility, solving difficult problems, helping a business grow, and becoming a trusted leader, we would love to meet you.

.

nts. The hook is usually in the middle of the video. You find it, pull it to the front, and build the clip as hook first, then story, then lesson.

.

 what becomes a clip?

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:

------------------------

So if you're someone who's:
